messages:
marta: Proposed cutover window for Starlight Systems (dedicated) — Thu Apr 28 02:00-03:00 UTC. Want to pin inference model runtime to `rtx-quant-v2.4.1` and app release `1.12.2`. Need approvals, infra reservation, and rollback thresholds. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/starlight-dedicated-cutover (please confirm you can access). @sam-devops can you reserve capacity and firewall changes?

deploy-bot: Automated job created by marta. Job ID: deploy-1837654321. Stages: canary(5%) -> scale -> verify -> cutover. ETA Thu Apr 28 02:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.

sam-devops: reserved node pool `starlight-prod-dedicated` for the window, 4xA100 pinned. Added maintenance window in infra calendar. I'll schedule the firewall rule change at T+15m and open egress for customer CIDR.

lee-sre: SRE scope - OK on the window. Proposed healthcheck thresholds: if 5xx > 1% OR p99 latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive 1m windows -> auto-rollback. We should warm KV cache before traffic shift. Canary config below, please review:
```
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 10m
  metrics:
    - name: p50_latency
      threshold_ms: 200
    - name: error_rate
      threshold_pct: 0.5
fallback_versions:
  - model: rtx-quant-v2.3.8
    reason: proven baseline
```

nina-pm: Product sign-off on model pin and release notes. We will reduce default `max_tokens` from 2048 -> 1024 for this customer to lower blowups on long prompts. I'll push a note to dashboard and the changelog.

jon-sales: Starlight ops pinged me — their nightly batch runs at 02:30 UTC and could conflict with heavy traffic. Can we avoid that or shift?

starlight-ops: we can move our batch to 03:30 for the duration of the maintenance if that helps. :white_check_mark:

marta: prefer to keep the 02:00 start; we'll delay our internal heavy jobs. @sam-devops confirm you can move internal cron jobs out of the window.

sam-devops: confirmed — internal jobs moved to 04:00 for that day.

security-bot: Security scan completed for `1.12.2` bundle and `rtx-quant-v2.4.1` artifacts. No critical findings. KMS keys unchanged; rotation not required pre-cutover. :white_check_mark: 

deploy-bot: Canary stage scheduled. Will push 5% traffic to `rtx-quant-v2.4.1` at T0, evaluate metrics for 10m. On threshold breach -> automatic rollback to `rtx-quant-v2.3.8`.

lee-sre: Note: if rollback occurs, KV cache rehydrate may take ~8m which could cause initial latency spikes. We'll run a priming job after a rollback to reduce tail latencies. Also adding a TTL tweak to reduce cache thrash.

marta: final approvals requested. Approvers: @lee-sre, @sam-devops, @nina-pm. React with :shipit: to approve the window and plan.

lee-sre: :shipit:

sam-devops: :shipit:

nina-pm: :shipit:

jon-sales: :thumbsup: (customer notified)

starlight-ops: :white_check_mark: (customer side good)

deploy-bot: Job queued: deploy-1837654321. Will post live progress and the deploy timeline in this thread at T-10m. Good luck team — monitor p50/p90/p99 and error_rate closely.

marta: thanks everyone. I'll be on the channel during the window. If rollback happens, we'll open a postmortem channel and tag the customer success lead.
